services.name: Paddle Board
services.desc: Note : 24 hours for any rental cancellation with the only exception being unsafe weather conditions. Note : The Renter agrees to return said vessel to the Rental Company by the time shown in the "Time in" space. Overtime charges are billed at a rate of $45.00 plus tax starting one minute after the scheduled "Time In" and every 15 minutes until return. The waterways of Naples are a beauty to behold, and we have multiple ways for our guests and the general public to get out on the water and have some fun in the Florida sun. Gather your family and friends and enjoy a leisurely day on the water in one of our pontoon or deck
